limitations: Capacity tickets are metadata only; current file APIs and private recycle payloads are not yet joined into one physical authority.
MetadataOnly transition setters are not filesystem evidence or execution authorization.
Armed allocations remain charged and block new admission; no adoption, expiry cleanup or release of owned allocations.
Ordinary portability refuses any scope/history; diagnostic DB snapshots include metadata only.
Current-Mac synthetic tests do not establish production NAS, macOS15 runtime, cross-Mac, power-loss durability, OS authentication or hostile-process fencing.
